CREATE TABLE "public"."AuditLog" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actor" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ip" text NOT NULL,
  "target" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "AuditLog_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Category" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Category_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Coupon" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "discountType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "usageCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "value" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Coupon_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Coupon_discountType_check_60789bc4" CHECK ("discountType" IN ('percentage', 'fixed')),
  CONSTRAINT "Coupon_status_check_8b06f885" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'expired', 'disabled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Customer" (
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Customer_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Kit" (
  "available" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mode" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Kit_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Kit_mode_check_9edd585a" CHECK ("mode" IN ('preselected', 'build_your_own'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."KitItem" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kitId" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "variationId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "KitItem_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "kit_item_quantity_positive_fc510296" CHECK ("quantity" > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MealSubscription" (
  "cadence" text NOT NULL,
  "customerId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "MealSubscription_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "MealSubscription_cadence_check_1a8bf214" CHECK ("cadence" IN ('weekly', 'monthly')),
  CONSTRAINT "MealSubscription_status_check_ad1d4a16" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'paused', 'canceled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Order" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customerId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  "totalCents" int4 NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Order_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Order_status_check_b7a5d829" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'ready', 'delivered', 'canceled', 'awaiting_payment', 'paid', 'ready_for_pickup', 'completed', 'refunded', 'expired')),
  CONSTRAINT "order_total_non_negative_192983b0" CHECK ("totalCents" >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Product" (
  "available" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "categoryId" text,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sortOrder" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Product_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Variation" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "priceCents" int4 NOT NULL,
  "productId" text NOT NULL,
  "stockMode" text NOT NULL,
  "stockQty" int4,
  "tenantId" text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "Variation_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Variation_stockMode_check_676ccf03" CHECK ("stockMode" IN ('controlled', 'unlimited')),
  CONSTRAINT "variation_price_non_negative_e06f6a4c" CHECK ("priceCents" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "variation_stock_non_negative_10ee5556" CHECK ("stockQty" IS NULL OR "stockQty" >= 0)
)
